name: Saguaro Holdings Corp.
summary: Saguaro Holdings Corp., headquartered in Larkspur, California, operates a diverse portfolio of businesses through its subsidiaries. Its operations encompass the exploration, environmental remediation, and treatment of oil and gas resources, including a 75% net interest in the Sullivan Tract located in the eastern and northeastern Maxine fields of Live Oak County, Texas. The company also manages a social online marketplace, offering consumers reduced-price goods and services from local businesses and internet retailers. Furthermore, it develops a software platform designed to help seniors, their families, caregivers, and healthcare professionals manage and lower medical costs. Additionally, Saguaro Holdings engages in the online retail of sporting goods.
